segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ סִידֵּר אֶת הַלֶּחֶם בַּשַּׁבָּת, וְאֶת הַבָּזִיכִין לְאַחַר הַשַּׁבָּת, וְהִקְטִיר אֶת הַבָּזִיכִין בַּשַּׁבָּת – פָּסוּל, אֵין חַיָּיבִין עֲלֵיהֶן מִשּׁוּם פִּיגּוּל, נוֹתָר, וְטָמֵא.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If one «arranged the bread» on the Table «on Shabbat but» arranged «the bowls» of frankincense only «after Shabbat,» then if he subsequently «burned» the frankincense placed in «the bowls on the» following «Shabbat,» the loaves are «unfit» for consumption, since the frankincense had not been on the Table for the entire week. Since the burning of the frankincense did not render the loaves permitted for consumption, «one is not» ever «liable for» eating «them due to» violation of the prohibitions of «piggul» or «notar, or» for partaking of the shewbread when one is «ritually impure.» One violates these prohibitions only if the frankincense is burned in a manner that permits consumption of the shewbread.

segments.he: סִידֵּר אֶת הַלֶּחֶם וְאֶת הַבָּזִיכִין בַּשַּׁבָּת, וְהִקְטִיר אֶת הַבָּזִיכִין לְאַחַר הַשַּׁבָּת – פְּסוּלָה, וְאֵין חַיָּיבִין עֲלֵיהֶן מִשּׁוּם פִּיגּוּל, נוֹתָר, וְטָמֵא.
segments.en: If one «arranged the bread and the bowls» of frankincense «on Shabbat but» then «burned» the frankincense that was in «the bowls after the» following «Shabbat,» that burning of the frankincense is «not valid» and the shewbread is unfit for consumption. «And» since the frankincense was not burned in a manner that permits consumption of the shewbread, «one is not» ever «liable for» eating «them due to» violation of the prohibitions of «piggul» or «notar, or» for partaking of the shewbread when one is «ritually impure.»

segments.he: סִידֵּר אֶת הַלֶּחֶם וְאֶת הַבָּזִיכִין לְאַחַר הַשַּׁבָּת, וְהִקְטִיר אֶת הַבָּזִיכִין בַּשַּׁבָּת – פְּסוּלָה. כֵּיצַד יַעֲשֶׂה? יַנִּיחֶנָּה לְשַׁבָּת הַבָּאָה, שֶׁאֲפִילּוּ הִיא עַל הַשּׁוּלְחָן יָמִים רַבִּים – אֵין בְּכָךְ כְּלוּם.
segments.en: If «one arranged the bread and the bowls» of frankincense «after Shabbat and burned» the frankincense that was in «the bowls on the» subsequent «Shabbat,» the burning of the frankincense is «not valid» and the shewbread is unfit for consumption. «How should» one «act» to prevent the shewbread from being rendered unfit? One should not remove the shewbread and frankincense from the Table on the subsequent Shabbat. Rather, «he should leave it» on the Table «until the following Shabbat,» so that it remains on the Table for a full week from Shabbat to Shabbat. It is permitted to leave the bread and frankincense on the Table beyond seven days, «as even» if «it is on the Table» for «many days» there is «nothing» wrong «with that,» i.e., it is not rendered unfit.
